Rule.name: Datetime to Timezone
Rule.Description: Parses an incoming ISO8601 Datetime with timezone offset or Date without time or timezone offset components (input) and converts it to a target ZoneId (timezone) passed from the transform attributes map. Optionally you can also specify a time in hours 0-23 to set when just passing a date without time component.
